mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO USER_ACNT ( EML_ADDR, ENPSWD, USER_TYPE_CD, LGN_TYPE, ACNT_STTS, USER_NM, NCNM, MBL_TELNO, MBL_TELNO_HASH, EML_VRFD_YN, EML_VRFD_DT, EML_VRFC_SRC, REG_DT, MDFCN_DT, RGTR_SN ) VALUES ( #{emlAddr}, #{enpswd}, #{userTypeCd}, #{lgnType}, #{acntStts}, #{userNm}, #{ncnm},
#{mblTelno,typeHandler=egovframework.eeum.base.crypto.MblTelnoEncryptedTypeHandler}, #{mblTelnoHash},
COALESCE(#{emlVrfdYn}, 'N'), CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{emlVrfdYn}, 'N') = 'Y' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END, #{emlVrfcSrc}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), NULL )
INSERT INTO USER_DTL_INFO (USER_SN, REG_DT, MDFCN_DT, RGTR_SN) VALUES (#{userSn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{userSn})
mapper.select: SELECT PRFL_IMG_FILE_SN FROM USER_DTL_INFO WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_DTL_INFO SET PRFL_IMG_FILE_SN = #{prflImgFileSn}, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{userSn} WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM USER_ACNT A WHERE A.USER_SN = #{userSn} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT x.trmsSn, x.trmsTypeCd, x.verNo, x.trmsTtl, x.esntlYn, x.agreYn, x.agreDt FROM ( SELECT t.TRMS_SN AS trmsSn, t.TRMS_TYPE_CD AS trmsTypeCd, t.VER_NO AS verNo, t.TRMS_TTL AS trmsTtl, t.ESNTL_YN AS esntlYn, a.AGRE_YN AS agreYn, a.AGRE_DT AS agreDt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.TRMS_TYPE_CD ORDER BY a.AGRE_DT DESC, a.TRMS_AGRE_SN DESC) AS rn FROM TRMS_AGRE_INFO a JOIN TRMS_MST t ON t.TRMS_SN = a.TRMS_SN WHERE a.USER_SN = #{userSn} ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.trmsTypeCd
SELECT ROLE_SN FROM ROLE_MST WHERE ROLE_CD = #{roleCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_ROLE (USER_SN, ROLE_SN, REG_DT, MDFCN_DT, RGTR_SN) VALUES (#{userSn}, #{roleSn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{userSn})
mapper.select: SELECT USER_SN, EML_ADDR, USER_TYPE_CD, LGN_TYPE, ACNT_STTS, USER_NM, NCNM, MBL_TELNO_VRFC_YN, EML_VRFD_YN, EML_VRFD_DT, EML_VRFC_SRC, REG_DT FROM USER_ACNT WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT ENPSWD FROM USER_ACNT WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_ACNT SET EML_VRFD_YN = 'Y', EML_VRFD_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), EML_VRFC_SRC = #{emlVrfcSrc}, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{userSn} WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND EML_VRFD_YN = 'N' AND ACNT_STTS IN ('ACTIVE', 'PENDING')
UPDATE USER_ACNT SET USER_NM = #{userNm}, NCNM = #{ncnm}, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{userSn} WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE USER_ACNT SET DEL_YN = 'Y', ACNT_STTS = 'WITHDRAWN', WHDWL_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{userSn} WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
